name: Yorgen Farmstead
summary: Defias outlaws hold Yorgen Farmstead in southern Duskwood. Sven Yorgen fled north to a camp along the Darkened Bank.

sections.title: A Ruined Homestead
sections.body: Yorgen Farmstead lies in southern Duskwood, where Sven Yorgen once worked the land. Danger drove him north to a makeshift camp along the Darkened Bank. Outlaws took the farm after he left, seeking ground beyond Stormwind's reach.

sections.title: Defias Infiltration
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood uses Yorgen Farmstead as a staging ground. Masked highwaymen and cutthroats hide among its fences and outbuildings, screened by dense trees. Defias assassins patrol the grounds and ambush travelers who trespass.

faq.answer: Sven Yorgen once owned and farmed Yorgen Farmstead. Rising dangers drove him from home to a solitary camp farther north along the Darkened Bank.
The Defias Brotherhood occupies the deserted farm. Cutpurses, bandits, and hidden assassins prowl its overgrown yards and barnyards, making any visit dangerous.
Sven Yorgen left the farm for a modest camp along the Darkened Bank. It lies north of Yorgen Farmstead beside the river between Duskwood and Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why is the Defias Brotherhood in Duskwood?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood has carried its operations far beyond Westfall. Disorganized rural settlements and weakened defenses let its agents establish hidden camps and strongholds beyond the reach of Stormwind's marshals.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can see Defias assassins using the neglected farmstead as a concealed hideout.
As an Alliance member, you can see how far the Defias Brotherhood has spread through Duskwood. The Night Watch struggles to keep order in Darkshire.
